original_target.title: Separation of measures by Cartan–Hadamard sliced distances
original_target.area: Statistical inference and optimal transport on manifolds

scope_comparison: The final JMLR Definition5 and section5.1 retain the general separation conjecture, proving pullback-Euclidean cases only. Both G/H families and the entire direction sphere are required. Hierarchical hybrid transforms retain component injectivity assumptions. The AISTATS2026 work studies Busemann functions on Wasserstein spaces, with closed forms for one-dimensional distributions/Gaussians, not all finite-dimensional Hadamard manifolds.
queries: "Cartan-Hadamard" "sliced" separation measures (site:arxiv.org OR site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com)
